all_three_original_criteria.requirement: Assign identical settings repeatedly and apply a multi-setting batch; assert bounded native/FX calls.
all_three_original_criteria.evidence: Actual native application counts and native property listeners: equal setters zero, one nested batch once, 1000 queued complete batches once

all_three_original_criteria.requirement: Thousands of resource failures: benchmark allocation/time and preserve required error metadata.
all_three_original_criteria.evidence: Actual library onReceivedError with 5000 controlled errors; every code/Unicode description, same collection, actual Compose observation invalidation and next-request reset; real current-thread allocation/nanosecond counters

all_three_original_criteria.requirement: Concurrent/UI-thread application still sees a coherent settings snapshot.
all_three_original_criteria.evidence: Deterministically blocked actual FX queue and AWT producer paused inside a batch; failed incoherent pair before fix, complete A2 then complete B after fix

benchmark_scope: One JDK17/Robolectric SDK34 host sample, controlled WebResourceError inputs. Copy reference is the original add/toList algorithm only, not a historical APK/native engine or a device performance/speedup claim.
